note: STACK1 messages (spec/STACK1.md section 2): written for this test, neutral, no clinical content.
messages: I want to feel calm and strong before my exam, like a lion, and see myself succeeding at work.
Before the presentation I want to see the room clearly, hear my own steady voice and feel my feet on the floor.
Help me stay focused like an eagle when I plan the week, and picture the finished project.
I want to feel patient like a bear when the queue is long, and breathe slowly.
When I start running in the morning I want to feel light and quick like a leopard.
I want to notice early when I get distracted, like a raven watching, and come back to the task.
Give me the courage of a lion to make the phone call I keep postponing.
I want to feel grounded before an important meeting and hear the words: I am ready.
Help me see myself finishing the race and feel the strength in my legs.
I want to relax my shoulders after work and smell something fresh like pine.
Before I cook for friends I want to feel relaxed and taste the dish in my mind first.
When I study languages I want to picture the words and hear them clearly.
I want a short routine to feel steady before driving in heavy traffic.
Help me feel focused like a tiger when I write, and see the page filling up.
I want to feel confident when I speak to a new client tomorrow at work.
Help me switch from work to home: see the door close, hear a soft tone, feel my breath slow down.
I want to feel energy and joy before training with my team.
When I wake up I want to feel clear, picture my day and say: I move, I act.
Help me stay calm and patient with my children in the evening, like a bear.
I want to see my goal for this year and feel committed to it.
Before a negotiation I want to feel like a lion and an eagle together: strong and seeing far.
I want to enjoy my walk in the park, notice the colours and the smell of the trees.
Help me feel steady and precise before a chess game.
I want to end the day feeling calm, see the stars and hear quiet music.
